title: Answer: no line between conscious and unconscious systems, only continua of degree

statements.text: The framework supports a panpsychist perspective in which the binary split between entities with and without agency, sentience and cognition is replaced by continua. No evident biological discontinuity marks organisms below which they are wholly unaware of their bodies or environments, and supra-organismal and artificial systems are not clearly excluded. Single cells, plants, birds and cephalopods are all candidates, and a quantum system with a classical memory has positive integrated information.
statements.scope: Minimal physicalism as a scale-free substrate for cognition and consciousness (2021) and A free energy principle for generic quantum systems (2021)

sources.quote: supporting a panpsychist perspective on questions of agency, sentience, and cognition.
there is no evident biological discontinuity below which organisms can clearly be viewed as completely unaware of their bodily states or their environments
Nor is it obvious that supra-organismal systems utterly lack phenomenal consciousness
